title: Get a permit to busk or perform in public places
what: Get the council's permit before busking or performing in streets, malls or other public places.

laws.title: Local Government Act 1993 New South Wales

sources.title: Busking permit council of the city of sydney
sources.publisher: Australian Business Licence and Information Service (ABLIS)
sources.quote: You will need this permit if you intend to busk or perform other forms of entertainment in a public place.

sources.title: Busking and Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander Cultural Practice Local Approvals Policy 2025
sources.quote: All people wishing to busk in the City must obtain an approval (Busking Permit) to busk in accordance with section 68 of the Local Government Act 1993 NSW.
